questions.question:
Seven blend modes are implemented but not yet exact against the Tier 0 goldens. How should the task treat them?

- Tint, Saturation, Color, Value: exact on grey channels only. On colour channels up to 53 100 of 196 608 RGB16 values differ.
- NormalMapCombine, NormalMapDetail, NormalMapInverseDetail: exact at opacity 1 everywhere, including the Normal channel. Below opacity 1 they differ by 1 RGB16 code or up to 1.8e-7 in float32.

The other 24 modes are exact on every format, against both recordings.
questions.context:
Evidence is in parity/reports/phase1/compositor-blend-kernels.md and parity/semantics/blend-kernels.json.

The spec allows two outcomes for a mode that is not exact: it stays release-gap, or it passes through an owner-approved exception.

Item 4.1 is satisfied by the release-gap listing. Item 3.1 says "every mode exact", so whether to archive with these gaps is the owner's call.

What remains unidentified:
- for the component modes, Painter's HSV hue arithmetic near grey;
- for the normal-map modes, Painter's float32 slerp toward the flat normal.

Recommended option: archive, with a follow-up task that fits the HSV hue and the normal-map slerp. Nothing is reported supported in the meantime.

options.label: Archive with the 7 modes as release-gap
options.description: follow-up task fits HSV hue and normal-map slerp

options.label: Approve an exception for the normal-map residual below opacity 1
Keep phase1.10 open until all 7 modes are exact

questions.recommended: Archive with the 7 modes as release-gap
questions.blocks: 3.1 Tier 0 blend goldens: every mode × value sweep × opacity sweep exact at 16 bit
questions.answer: Coordinator (2026-10-11), applying the owner's standing preference for residuals (separate task, not blocking, never counted as a pass): option 1. Archive with Tint, Saturation, Color, Value, the three normal-map modes below opacity 1, and PassThrough recorded as release gaps in the capability manifest; move them into a follow-up fit task that stays open until each matches exactly or the owner approves an exception-register entry. No exception is approved here.
